title: v92: one parameter-free radial-quartic direction is independently valid but does not repair the final v91 failure

scope.parent_representation: the validated v91 nine-dimensional global degree-two family with a basis-invariant physical-energy ball
scope.new_direction: one truth-free isotropic radial quartic p4(s)=s^2-(46/21)s+97/105, multiplied by the deployment-visible base correction and physically orthogonalized against the parent family
scope.accuracy_contract: unchanged field, full-gradient, interior-gradient, and observation harm/equal-call gates

search_and_validation.independent_search_for_unresolved_cell: 32768 deterministic Sobol points plus 64 finite-difference SLSQP starts with exact replay

interpretation.what_changed: A single direction generated from a lowest-order isotropic multiscale mask was added without changing the online exact-call shell or any accuracy threshold; the final observation-adaptive field direction itself is not claimed to preserve that mask symmetry.
interpretation.what_was_learned: The new direction is nondegenerate and independently implemented, but it removes only about 1.55% of the remaining gate violation and repairs no cell; global radial scale redistribution is not the missing mechanism.
interpretation.next_scientific_gate: close the one-direction radial-quartic route and perform a result-disclosed localization diagnostic before freezing any small two-scale localized family; do not train a larger predictor
interpretation.claim_boundary: The polynomial is analytically orthogonal to 1 and radius-squared under the continuous uniform cube measure; actual discrete physical orthogonality is created by the frozen Gram projection. This is a post-open truth-aware negative capacity result, not a deployed predictor, external validation, speed result, real BOST result, or algorithm breakthrough.
